value.body: Art teachers in Kendriya Vidyalayas, Navodaya Vidyalayas and state government schools teach drawing, painting and craft, and run school art activities. Posts are usually at the trained-graduate (TGT) or equivalent level.

items.label: KVS TGT (Art Education)
items.value: Five-year diploma in drawing & painting / sculpture / graphic art, or equivalent degree
items.note: Plus working knowledge of Hindi and English

items.label: Teacher eligibility test
items.value: CTET Paper II may be required
items.note: Depends on the recruiter and notification

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A fine-arts degree (BFA) or equivalent recognised diploma. Some recruiters also ask for a B.Ed or an art-teaching qualification and a TET pass. KVS and NVS recruit through centralised notifications; state schools recruit through state teacher-recruitment boards or PSCs.

value.title: At a glance
items: Art-teacher vacancies are far fewer than for core subjects.
Eligibility differs a lot between KVS, NVS and each state — read the specific notification.
Private schools, art studios and coaching also hire art teachers, often on lower pay.
